A '''steel mattock''' is a [[mattock]] of the [[Steel equipment|steel]] tier, made by smithing an [[iron hoe]] (or [[iron mattock]]) with [[steel alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot; without one, the same iron hoe and alloy make a [[steel hoe]]. Enchantments on the base item carry over.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks shovel and hoe blocks at speed 7 and has 3000 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 2. Steel tools reuse the removed stone tools' item IDs, so where the item sets no attack attributes of its own it keeps the stone tool's values.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 3 (real value 2).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_mattock.json}}</ref>
